sections.heading: Work
sections.body: Doing the BlueDot Technical AI Safety course (facilitated by BAISH, the Buenos Aires AI Safety Hub) and self-studying ARENA on the side.

sections.heading: Reading
sections.body: El infinito en un junco by Irene Vallejo.

sections.heading: Writing
sections.body: Drafting a paper on which instructions LLMs actually retain across long coding sessions (Not All Instructions Are Forgotten Equal). Bayesian ordered logistic over 244 compliance observations; treatment effects span an order of magnitude across instruction types.

sections.heading: Thinking about
sections.body: AI safety, particularly how you tell whether a system has internalized a rule versus pattern-matched around it.
